body.title: Webhook verification failed
body.detail: The X-Signature header did not verify.

steps.note: Declared, so Edge lets it through, but there is no signature. WebhookVerification offers HmacSha256 and SharedToken only; there is no way to map a hook without one.
Not declared, on a private app, with no session: Edge treats it as any signed-out request. A POST gets 401 with a Location header to the app's sign-in page; the app never sees it.
